config.script:
dbstatus=self.session.custom.dbstatus
	
	messageboxparams={"data":{"icon": "material/info",
			  "title": "",
			  "level": "",
			  "message": ""
			  }
			  }
	
	
	if dbstatus=="Valid":

		rowData=self.view.params.rowData
		params={"sp_name":rowData['sp_name'],"sp_id":rowData["sp_id"]}							  
		system.perspective.openPopup("QueryScript", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/SP_Details",params, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
	
	else:
		
		messageboxparams["data"]["title"]= "Data-Base Connection Error"
		messageboxparams["data"]["level"]= "error"
		messageboxparams["data"]["message"]= "The database connection is not valid."
						  
		system.perspective.openPopup("dbError", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Message_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
